entities.name: APN-AMBR
entities.description: The APN Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate (APN-AMBR) information element indicates the maximum allowed aggregate bit rate for all non-GBR bearers associated with a specific APN.

entities.name: APN-AMBR changed by network
entities.description: Condition indicating that the APN-AMBR value has been modified by the network.

relations.description: The APN-AMBR IE is included in messages when the network has changed the APN-AMBR value.
